podcast.body: Released on May 14, 1982, this album was the result of producer Glenn Johns cutting, editing, and re-sequencing the material from the *Rat Patrol from Fort Bragg* sessions. This was Joe Strummer's preferred outcome, a "nice tight single album" that CBS could effectively promote, contrasting with Mick Jones's original double album vision. "In April 1982, producer Glenn Johns was brought in to sort it all out. He cut and edited and re-sequenced the whole thing. And the final result was an album called Combat Rock, which was released on May 14, 1982."
